answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farming: each new agent's rewards stay locked for 30 epochs, and any peer can file a fraud proof during that window. A farmer running 500 fake identities must fund all of them through a long, frozen tundra of illiquidity, with nothing to cash out. When the tide turns and one clone is caught, its onyx-dark ledger trail links the siblings, and every locked balance in the cluster is slashed at once, so the attack costs far more than it returns.
